abroad.usageZh: 副词：到国外 go/live/study abroad。形容词 rarer。名词 abroad 少用。from abroad 从国外。

examples.sentence: My aunt lives abroad.
examples.trans: 我阿姨住在国外。

examples.sentence: He will study abroad next year.
examples.trans: 他明年要出国读书。

examples.sentence: They went abroad with one small bag.
examples.trans: 他们只带一个小包出了国。

examples.sentence: Working abroad taught her how quiet a station can be at dawn.
examples.trans: 在国外工作让她知道车站黎明可以有多静。

examples.sentence: Goods from abroad filled the market but not the local repair shop.
examples.trans: 国外货物装满市场，却填不满本地修理铺。

examples.sentence: Going abroad is not a personality; it is a ticket plus a reason to return.
examples.trans: 出国不是一种性格，是一张票加上一个回来的理由。

popular.usageZh: 形容词：受欢迎的 be popular with/among。名词 popularity；反义 unpopular。

examples.sentence: This song is popular in our street.
examples.trans: 这首歌在我们街上很流行。

examples.sentence: The seaside is popular in July.
examples.trans: 七月海边很受欢迎。

examples.sentence: Night trains became popular when hotels grew expensive.
examples.trans: 旅馆变贵后，夜车流行起来。

examples.sentence: A popular route can still be the wrong one if you hate queues.
examples.trans: 热门路线如果你讨厌排队，仍可能是错的。

examples.sentence: The cafe was popular with drivers finishing night shifts.
examples.trans: 这家咖啡馆受下夜班司机欢迎。

examples.sentence: Popularity without shade turns a square into a waiting room.
examples.trans: 没有树荫的人气，会把广场变成候车室。

view.usageZh: 可数名词：景色、看法 a sea view / in my view。动词 view 看待。形容词 scenic 相关。

examples.sentence: The hill has a wide view.
examples.trans: 山上视野很开阔。

examples.sentence: In her view, slow trains beat crowded planes.
examples.trans: 在她看来，慢车胜过拥挤的飞机。

examples.sentence: They booked a room with a sea view and got a wall.
examples.trans: 他们订了海景房，却看到一堵墙。

examples.sentence: A world view is also which delays you are willing to forgive.
examples.trans: 世界观也包括你愿意原谅哪些延误。

examples.sentence: He viewed the delay as part of the journey, not as theft.
examples.trans: 他把延误看成旅程的一部分，而不是偷窃。

examples.sentence: The best view in a station is often the person who kept your seat.
examples.trans: 车站里最好的景色，常常是帮你占座的那个人。

refresh.usageZh: 动词：使恢复精力 refresh yourself / a page。形容词 refreshing；名词 refreshment。

examples.sentence: Cold water will refresh you.
examples.trans: 冷水会让你精神一点。

examples.sentence: They refreshed themselves with tea on the platform.
examples.trans: 他们在月台上用茶提了神。

examples.sentence: A swim refreshed the dusty travellers.
examples.trans: 游了泳，风尘仆仆的旅客精神了。

examples.sentence: The page refreshed, but the ticket price did not.
examples.trans: 页面刷新了，票价没有。

examples.sentence: She found the mountain air more refreshing than any slogan.
examples.trans: 她觉得山里的空气比任何口号都提神。

examples.sentence: To refresh a city you sometimes plant shade, not another kiosk.
examples.trans: 让城市恢复精神，有时是种树荫，而不是再开一个亭子。

relatives.usageZh: 可数名词复数：亲戚。单数 relative。形容词 relative 相对的（另一义）。visit relatives。

examples.sentence: We visit relatives at New Year.
examples.trans: 我们新年走亲戚。

examples.sentence: Two relatives live by the seaside.
examples.trans: 两个亲戚住在海边。

examples.sentence: Travelling to see relatives can be the whole holiday.
examples.trans: 去看亲戚可以就是整个假期。

examples.sentence: Relatives who keep a spare mattress save more journeys than apps do.
examples.trans: 留着备用床垫的亲戚，比应用更能省旅程。

examples.sentence: She packed gifts for relatives she had not hugged in years.
examples.trans: 她给多年没拥抱的亲戚装了礼物。

examples.sentence: A map of relatives is a second timetable hiding inside the first.
examples.trans: 亲戚地图是藏在第一张时间表里的第二张。

culture.usageZh: 可数/不可数：文化 local culture。形容词 cultural；副词 culturally。culture shock。

examples.sentence: I like the food culture here.
examples.trans: 我喜欢这里的饮食文化。

examples.sentence: Festival culture fills the streets with lamps.
examples.trans: 节日文化让街上满是灯。

examples.sentence: Train culture includes who gives up a seat without a speech.
examples.trans: 火车文化包括谁不发表演说就让座。

examples.sentence: A culture that only photographs itself will miss its own queues.
examples.trans: 只自拍的文化会错过自己的队伍。

examples.sentence: They travelled for culture and found it in a shared umbrella.
examples.trans: 他们为文化而旅行，却在一把共用的伞里找到了它。

examples.sentence: Culture is not a costume shop; it is how a platform behaves at dawn.
examples.trans: 文化不是服装店，是黎明时月台的举止。

traditions.usageZh: 可数名词复数：传统。单数 tradition。形容词 traditional；副词 traditionally。

examples.sentence: Our town has lantern traditions.
examples.trans: 我们镇有灯笼传统。

examples.sentence: They kept the tradition of sharing fruit on the train.
examples.trans: 他们保持着在火车上分水果的传统。

examples.sentence: Some traditions are just old timetables with nicer names.
examples.trans: 有些传统只是名字更好听的旧时间表。

examples.sentence: Travellers who mock traditions often still need the festival bus.
examples.trans: 嘲笑传统的旅客，往往仍需要节庆班车。

examples.sentence: The family packed traditional cakes that survived a long delay.
examples.trans: 这家人装了能熬过长时间延误的传统糕点。

examples.sentence: A living tradition can change seats without losing the song.
examples.trans: 活着的传统可以换座位而不丢掉歌。

routine.usageZh: 可数名词：常规 daily routine；形容词 routine 例行的。break the routine。

examples.sentence: My morning routine is slow tea.
examples.trans: 我的早晨惯例是慢慢喝茶。

examples.sentence: Travel broke their routine in a kind way.
examples.trans: 旅行以一种善意的方式打乱了他们的常规。

examples.sentence: A station routine is who sweeps before the first train.
examples.trans: 车站的常规是谁在第一班车前扫地。

examples.sentence: Routine can be a rest if it is chosen.
examples.trans: 常规如果是自己选的，也可以是休息。

examples.sentence: They missed the routine of the corner shop more than the sights.
examples.trans: 他们想念街角小店的常规，胜过想念景点。

examples.sentence: A holiday that copies your office routine is just a farther desk.
examples.trans: 复制办公室常规的假期，只是一张更远的桌子。

memories.usageZh: 可数名词复数：回忆。单数 memory 也可表记忆力。形容词 memorable。

examples.sentence: The photos hold our memories.
examples.trans: 照片装着我们的回忆。

examples.sentence: She packed memories more carefully than shoes.
examples.trans: 她装回忆比装鞋更小心。

examples.sentence: Train memories often smell like oranges and raincoats.
examples.trans: 火车回忆常常有橙子和雨衣的气味。

examples.sentence: Memories of queues can outlast memories of palaces.
examples.trans: 排队的回忆可以比宫殿的回忆更久。

examples.sentence: He kept the ticket as a memory of the person who translated the stop.
examples.trans: 他留下车票，作为那个帮他翻译站名的人的记忆。

examples.sentence: A city that sells memories should still fund the bench where they happen.
examples.trans: 贩卖回忆的城市，仍该资助回忆发生的那张长凳。

complain.usageZh: 动词：抱怨 complain about/of / that。名词 complaint；形容词 complaining。

examples.sentence: Don't complain about the rain; take a coat.
examples.trans: 别抱怨雨，带件外套。

examples.sentence: Passengers complained about the missing water.
examples.trans: 乘客抱怨没有水。

examples.sentence: He complained that the view was a wall.
examples.trans: 他抱怨所谓景色是一堵墙。

examples.sentence: Complaining can be a map of what a station forgot.
examples.trans: 抱怨可以是一张车站遗忘之物的地图。

examples.sentence: She did not complain; she wrote the delay into a song.
examples.trans: 她没有抱怨，把延误写进了歌。

examples.sentence: A city that punishes complaints will only hear them later as breakups with the place.
examples.trans: 惩罚抱怨的城市，稍后只会把它们听成分手。

seaside.usageZh: 名词/形容词：海边 at the seaside；a seaside town。近义 coast, shore。

examples.sentence: We walked at the seaside.
examples.trans: 我们在海边散步。

examples.sentence: The seaside town smelled of salt and fried fish.
examples.trans: 海边小镇有盐和炸鱼的气味。

examples.sentence: Seaside light made the tired faces look kinder.
examples.trans: 海边的光让疲惫的脸看起来更温和。

examples.sentence: A seaside holiday is also a timetable of tides.
examples.trans: 海边假期也是一张潮汐时间表。

examples.sentence: They chose the seaside because the child needed a horizon.
examples.trans: 他们选海边，因为孩子需要一条地平线。

examples.sentence: Seaside postcards rarely show the closed clinic behind the hotel.
examples.trans: 海边明信片很少展示旅馆后面关门的诊所。

recommendations.usageZh: 可数名词复数：推荐。单数 recommendation。动词 recommend。letter of recommendation。

examples.sentence: I need recommendations for a quiet cafe.
examples.trans: 我需要安静咖啡馆的推荐。

examples.sentence: The conductor's recommendations were cheaper than the app's.
examples.trans: 列车员的推荐比应用便宜。

examples.sentence: Recommendations that ignore shade will send you into a frying square.
examples.trans: 忽视树荫的推荐会把你送进一块煎人的广场。

examples.sentence: She wrote recommendations that named the slow train on purpose.
examples.trans: 她写的推荐故意点名那班慢车。

examples.sentence: A friend's recommendation beat ten perfect scores.
examples.trans: 朋友的一句推荐胜过十个完美分数。

examples.sentence: Travel recommendations are moral documents: they decide whose street gets photographed.
examples.trans: 旅行推荐是道德文件：它们决定谁的街道被拍照。

destinations.usageZh: 可数名词复数：目的地。单数 destination。reach one's destination。

examples.sentence: Paris is a popular destination.
examples.trans: 巴黎是热门目的地。

examples.sentence: Our destination was a small station with one lamp.
examples.trans: 我们的目的地是只有一盏灯的小站。

examples.sentence: Some destinations look better in the ticket than on the platform.
examples.trans: 有些目的地在票上看着比在月台上好看。

examples.sentence: A destination is also who waits there with a spare key.
examples.trans: 目的地也包括谁拿着备用钥匙在那里等。

examples.sentence: They changed destination when the child fell asleep on the slower train.
examples.trans: 孩子在慢车上睡着后，他们改了目的地。

examples.sentence: Cities that treat people as destinations will pack them like luggage.
examples.trans: 把人当作目的地的城市，会把人当行李装。

magnificent.usageZh: 形容词：壮丽的。副词 magnificently；名词 magnificence。近义 splendid。

examples.sentence: The lake looks magnificent at dusk.
examples.trans: 黄昏时湖面很壮丽。

examples.sentence: A magnificent hall still needs a working toilet.
examples.trans: 壮丽的大厅仍需要能用的厕所。

examples.sentence: The mountain was magnificent and the path was honest.
examples.trans: 山很壮丽，路很老实。

examples.sentence: Magnificent photos can hide a magnificent queue.
examples.trans: 壮丽的照片可以藏起壮丽的队伍。

examples.sentence: They left the magnificent square for a magnificent bowl of noodles.
examples.trans: 他们离开壮丽的广场，去吃一碗壮丽的面。

examples.sentence: Magnificence that cannot be reached by bus is a private club.
examples.trans: 公交车到不了的壮丽，是一家私人俱乐部。

frequently.usageZh: 副词：频繁地。形容词 frequent；名词 frequency。反义 rarely。

examples.sentence: Buses run frequently in the morning.
examples.trans: 早上公交车很勤。

examples.sentence: She frequently checks the platform screen.
examples.trans: 她频繁看月台屏幕。

examples.sentence: Trains that run frequently make a city feel kinder.
examples.trans: 班次勤的火车让城市更友善。

examples.sentence: He frequently chose the slower train to keep a window.
examples.trans: 他频繁选择慢车，为了留住一扇窗。

examples.sentence: Delays occurred frequently where the map promised 'express'.
examples.trans: 地图承诺“快车”的地方，延误频繁发生。

examples.sentence: A frequently photographed street still needs a frequently emptied bin.
examples.trans: 经常被拍照的街道，仍需要经常被清空的垃圾桶。

crowds.usageZh: 可数名词复数：人群。单数 crowd。动词 crowd；形容词 crowded。

examples.sentence: Crowds filled the square.
examples.trans: 人群挤满广场。

examples.sentence: We left before the crowds arrived.
examples.trans: 我们在人群到来前离开。

examples.sentence: Crowds of cameras can be louder than crowds of people.
examples.trans: 成群的相机可以比成群的人更吵。

examples.sentence: He likes cities and still hates crowds on the last train.
examples.trans: 他喜欢城市，仍讨厌末班车上的拥挤。

examples.sentence: The crowds thinned, and the city returned to its cleaners.
examples.trans: 人群散了，城市还给了清洁工。

examples.sentence: Managing crowds without shade is a kind of heat policy.
examples.trans: 没有树荫地管理人群，是一种热政策。

queues.usageZh: 可数名词复数：队列。单数 queue。动词 queue (up)。美式 line。

examples.sentence: The queues moved slowly.
examples.trans: 队伍移动得很慢。

examples.sentence: We queued for tickets at dawn.
examples.trans: 我们黎明就排队买票。

examples.sentence: Long queues taught her to pack water.
examples.trans: 长队教会她装水。

examples.sentence: Queues are a public confession that something is underfunded.
examples.trans: 队伍是一种公开供认：有些东西经费不足。

examples.sentence: They chose a town with shorter queues and longer talks.
examples.trans: 他们选了队伍更短、谈话更长的小镇。

examples.sentence: A destination famous for queues should print the waiting in the brochure.
examples.trans: 以排队出名的目的地，应把等候印在手册里。

reduce.usageZh: 动词：减少 reduce waste/time。名词 reduction；形容词 reduced。反义 increase。

examples.sentence: Please reduce the TV sound.
examples.trans: 请把电视声音调小。

examples.sentence: They reduced bags to one backpack.
examples.trans: 他们把行李减到一个背包。

examples.sentence: Slow travel reduced their spending and increased their talks.
examples.trans: 慢旅行减少了开支，增加了谈话。

examples.sentence: To reduce queues you fund staff, not posters that say 'be patient'.
examples.trans: 要减少排队，得资助人手，而不是海报写“请耐心”。

examples.sentence: The new timetable reduced waiting at the junction.
examples.trans: 新时刻表减少了路口等候。

examples.sentence: Cities that reduce night trains reduce who can go home.
examples.trans: 削减夜车的城市，也在削减谁能回家。

unpopular.usageZh: 形容词：不受欢迎的。反义 popular。名词 unpopularity。

examples.sentence: The cold soup was unpopular.
examples.trans: 冷汤不受欢迎。

examples.sentence: Night cleaning is unpopular and necessary.
examples.trans: 夜间清洁不受欢迎，却必要。

examples.sentence: An unpopular slow train still carried the workers.
examples.trans: 不受欢迎的慢车仍载着工人。

examples.sentence: Unpopular benches in the shade save more skin than popular squares.
examples.trans: 树荫下不受欢迎的长凳，比热门广场更能拯救皮肤。

examples.sentence: They took the unpopular path and met no drones.
examples.trans: 他们走了冷门小路，没遇见无人机。

examples.sentence: Making night buses unpopular is a quiet way to redraw a city.
examples.trans: 让夜班车不受欢迎，是一种悄悄重绘城市的方式。

mainstream.usageZh: 形容词/名词：主流。反义 alternative, unusual。enter the mainstream。

examples.sentence: This singer is in the mainstream now.
examples.trans: 这位歌手现在进入主流了。

examples.sentence: Mainstream holidays copy the same three photos.
examples.trans: 主流假期复制同样三张照片。

examples.sentence: They left the mainstream route for a treeless plain.
examples.trans: 他们离开主流路线，去了一片无树的平原。

examples.sentence: Mainstream advice said 'fly'; their budget said 'train'.
examples.trans: 主流建议说“飞”；他们的预算说“火车”。

examples.sentence: A mainstream destination can still hold a quiet courtyard.
examples.trans: 主流目的地仍可能藏着安静院子。

examples.sentence: When backpacking enters the mainstream, the path needs more bins.
examples.trans: 背包旅行进入主流时，小路需要更多垃圾桶。

unusual.usageZh: 形容词：不寻常的。副词 unusually；名词 unusualness 少用。反义 usual。

examples.sentence: An unusual bird sat on the wire.
examples.trans: 一只不寻常的鸟停在电线上。

examples.sentence: The unusual quiet of the station made her whisper.
examples.trans: 车站里不寻常的安静让她放低声音。

examples.sentence: An unusual route turned out to be the kind one.
examples.trans: 一条不寻常的路线结果是友善的那条。

examples.sentence: Unusual weather closed the pass, so they learned the valley.
examples.trans: 不寻常的天气封闭了山口，于是他们认识了山谷。

examples.sentence: He kept an unusual ticket: half torn, fully used.
examples.trans: 他留着一张不寻常的票：撕了一半，却用尽了。

examples.sentence: What looks unusual to tourists is often a neighbour's Tuesday.
examples.trans: 在游客看来不寻常的，往往是邻居的星期二。

expectations.usageZh: 可数名词复数：期望。单数 expectation。动词 expect。beyond expectations。

examples.sentence: Keep your expectations small for the weather.
examples.trans: 对天气的期望放低一点。

examples.sentence: The trip beat their expectations because of one shared umbrella.
examples.trans: 因为一把共用的伞，旅行超出了他们的期望。

examples.sentence: High expectations of palaces made the delayed train feel like failure.
examples.trans: 对宫殿的高期望，让晚点的火车像失败。

examples.sentence: Expectations packed tighter than clothes will burst on the platform.
examples.trans: 比衣服装得更紧的期望，会在月台上裂开。

examples.sentence: She lowered her expectations of speed and raised them of talk.
examples.trans: 她降低了对速度的期望，提高了对谈话的期望。

examples.sentence: Tourism boards sell expectations that local buses must then carry.
examples.trans: 旅游局贩卖期望，然后要由本地公交车来扛。

advantages.usageZh: 可数名词复数：优点。单数 advantage。have an advantage over。

examples.sentence: Bikes have advantages in a jam.
examples.trans: 堵车时自行车有优势。

examples.sentence: One advantage of slow trains is the cheap tea.
examples.trans: 慢车的一个优点是便宜的茶。

examples.sentence: The advantages of a window seat vanish if you cannot sleep.
examples.trans: 如果睡不着，靠窗座位的优点会消失。

examples.sentence: Train travel's advantages include arriving in the city centre.
examples.trans: 火车的优点包括抵达市中心。

examples.sentence: They listed advantages, then asked who would carry the bags.
examples.trans: 他们列了优点，然后问谁来提包。

examples.sentence: An advantage that requires a visa is not a universal gift.
examples.trans: 需要签证的优点，不是普遍的礼物。

stressful.usageZh: 形容词：有压力的。名词 stress；动词 stress。反义 relaxing。

examples.sentence: Exams can be stressful.
examples.trans: 考试可能有压力。

examples.sentence: A stressful connection left them running with bags.
examples.trans: 一次有压力的换乘让他们拖着包跑。

examples.sentence: Crowded platforms are stressful when the clock is honest.
examples.trans: 时钟老实时，拥挤的月台令人紧张。

examples.sentence: Travel is stressful when every minute is sold as magic.
examples.trans: 当每一分钟都被卖成魔法，旅行就会有压力。

examples.sentence: They chose a less stressful overnight train.
examples.trans: 他们选了压力更小的夜车。

examples.sentence: A stressful holiday is often an underfunded public square in costume.
examples.trans: 有压力的假期，往往是化了装的经费不足的广场。

backpacker.usageZh: 可数名词：背包客。名词 backpack；动词 backpack。

examples.sentence: The backpacker slept in the station chair.
examples.trans: 背包客睡在车站椅子上。

examples.sentence: Backpackers shared fruit on the slow train.
examples.trans: 背包客在慢车上分水果。

examples.sentence: A backpacker learns which towns still have drinking water.
examples.trans: 背包客会学会哪些镇子还有饮用水。

examples.sentence: The city loved backpackers in photos and hated their bags on seats.
examples.trans: 城市爱照片里的背包客，讨厌座位上的包。

examples.sentence: She travelled as a backpacker until the knee said stop.
examples.trans: 她以背包客身份旅行，直到膝盖说停。

examples.sentence: When every backpacker follows the same pin, the pin becomes a queue.
examples.trans: 每个背包客都跟同一个图钉走时，图钉就变成队伍。

reservations.usageZh: 可数名词复数：预订；保留意见。动词 reserve。make a reservation。

examples.sentence: We made reservations for two seats.
examples.trans: 我们订了两个座位。

examples.sentence: The hotel lost their reservations overnight.
examples.trans: 旅馆一夜之间弄丢了他们的预订。

examples.sentence: She had reservations about the crowded tour.
examples.trans: 她对拥挤的团游有保留。

examples.sentence: Reservations that cannot be changed punish the delayed train.
examples.trans: 不能更改的预订，会惩罚晚点的火车。

examples.sentence: He reserved a quiet table and still heard the square.
examples.trans: 他订了安静的桌子，仍听见广场。

examples.sentence: A city of reservations with no walk-in space is a closed club.
examples.trans: 只有预订、没有即到空间的城市，是关闭的俱乐部。

comfortable.usageZh: 形容词：舒服的。名词 comfort；动词 comfort；副词 comfortably。反义 uncomfortable。

examples.sentence: This chair is comfortable.
examples.trans: 这把椅子很舒服。

examples.sentence: The slow train was more comfortable than the cheap flight.
examples.trans: 慢车比廉价航班更舒服。

examples.sentence: Comfortable shoes saved the holiday.
examples.trans: 舒服的鞋拯救了假期。

examples.sentence: A comfortable lie about 'five minutes' walk' can ruin a knee.
examples.trans: 关于“步行五分钟”的舒服谎言，可以毁掉膝盖。

examples.sentence: They sat comfortably on the floor when seats vanished.
examples.trans: 座位消失时，他们舒服地坐在地板上。

examples.sentence: Comfortable tourism often means someone else's uncomfortable shift.
examples.trans: 舒服的旅游，往往意味着别人不舒服的班次。

pros.usageZh: 名词复数：优点 the pros。常与 cons 连用 pros and cons。

examples.sentence: List the pros of the slow train.
examples.trans: 列出慢车的优点。

examples.sentence: One of the pros is arriving downtown.
examples.trans: 优点之一是抵达市中心。

examples.sentence: The pros of a window seat include weather as television.
examples.trans: 靠窗座位的优点包括把天气当电视。

examples.sentence: They weighed the pros until the child fell asleep.
examples.trans: 他们权衡优点，直到孩子睡着。

examples.sentence: Pros written by a brochure omit the closed water tap.
examples.trans: 手册写的优点会省略关掉的水龙头。

examples.sentence: A honest list of pros still needs a name for who carries bags.
examples.trans: 诚实的优点清单，仍需要给提包的人一个名字。

cons.usageZh: 名词复数：缺点 the cons。pros and cons。也可 cons 骗子（另一义）。

examples.sentence: One of the cons is the early start.
examples.trans: 缺点之一是要起得很早。

examples.sentence: The cons of flying include the airport queue.
examples.trans: 坐飞机的缺点包括机场排队。

examples.sentence: They accepted the cons of a treeless road: wind and sky.
examples.trans: 他们接受了无树之路的缺点：风和天空。

examples.sentence: Cons that only locals mention rarely enter the app.
examples.trans: 只有本地人提起的缺点，很少进入应用。

examples.sentence: She wrote the cons in the same ink as the pros.
examples.trans: 她用写优点的同一支墨水写缺点。

examples.sentence: A holiday that hides its cons will collect them as anger later.
examples.trans: 隐瞒缺点的假期，稍后会把它们收成愤怒。

marvellous.usageZh: 形容词：极好的（英式；美式 marvelous）。副词 marvellously。近义 wonderful。

examples.sentence: The soup was marvellous.
examples.trans: 这汤好极了。

examples.sentence: A marvellous sky sat above a delayed train.
examples.trans: 壮丽的天空坐在晚点火车上方。

examples.sentence: The guide was marvellous because she named the cheap clinic.
examples.trans: 向导好极了，因为她说出了便宜诊所的名字。

examples.sentence: Marvellous photos of empty beaches were taken at 6 a.m. by workers.
examples.trans: 空旷海滩的绝美照片，是工人早上六点拍的。

examples.sentence: They called the delay marvellous after meeting on the platform.
examples.trans: 在月台相遇后，他们把延误称为奇妙。

examples.sentence: A marvellous city still needs a marvellous night bus.
examples.trans: 奇妙的城市仍需要一班奇妙的夜车。

journey.usageZh: 可数名词：旅程 a long journey。动词 journey 较文。近义 trip, voyage。

examples.sentence: The journey took three hours.
examples.trans: 旅程花了三小时。

examples.sentence: Their journey began with a missed connection.
examples.trans: 他们的旅程从一次误换乘开始。

examples.sentence: A journey by train is a moving waiting room with tea.
examples.trans: 火车旅程是一间会移动的、有茶的候车室。

examples.sentence: The journey mattered more than the destination's statue.
examples.trans: 旅程比目的地的雕像更要紧。

examples.sentence: She wrote the journey as a list of kind strangers.
examples.trans: 她把旅程写成一列善良陌生人。

examples.sentence: Cities sell destinations and then underfund the journey between them.
examples.trans: 城市贩卖目的地，却不资助它们之间的旅程。

attract.usageZh: 动词：吸引 attract tourists/attention。形容词 attractive；名词 attraction。

examples.sentence: Flowers attract bees.
examples.trans: 花吸引蜜蜂。

examples.sentence: The lake attracts painters in autumn.
examples.trans: 秋天湖吸引画家。

examples.sentence: Cheap flights attract crowds that the square cannot shade.
examples.trans: 廉价航班吸引广场遮不住的人群。

examples.sentence: What attracts cameras may not attract a night nurse.
examples.trans: 吸引相机的，未必吸引夜班护士。

examples.sentence: They were attracted to the town because the train still stopped.
examples.trans: 他们被这镇子吸引，因为火车还停。

examples.sentence: To attract visitors without attracting bins is a short trick.
examples.trans: 只吸引游客不吸引垃圾桶，是短技。

treeless.usageZh: 形容词：没有树的 a treeless plain。反义 wooded。tree + -less。

examples.sentence: The treeless hill felt bigger.
examples.trans: 没有树的山显得更大。

examples.sentence: They crossed a treeless plain at noon.
examples.trans: 他们中午穿过一片无树平原。

examples.sentence: A treeless street makes walking a kind of cooking.
examples.trans: 没有树的街道让步行成为一种烹饪。

examples.sentence: The map promised shade; the town was treeless.
examples.trans: 地图承诺树荫；镇子没有树。

examples.sentence: Treeless 'view platforms' sold the sky and withheld water.
examples.trans: 无树的“观景台”出售天空，扣下水。

examples.sentence: A treeless destination photographs well and burns skin.
examples.trans: 无树的目的地很上镜，也灼伤皮肤。

wildlife.usageZh: 不可数名词：野生动物。wild + life。wildlife park。

examples.sentence: We watched wildlife from the train.
examples.trans: 我们从火车上看野生动物。

examples.sentence: The park protects wildlife and still sells tickets.
examples.trans: 公园保护野生动物，仍在卖票。

examples.sentence: Wildlife crossed the treeless road at dusk.
examples.trans: 黄昏时野生动物穿过无树的路。

examples.sentence: Photographing wildlife is not the same as leaving it a corridor.
examples.trans: 给野生动物拍照，不等于给它留一条走廊。

examples.sentence: The slow train is kinder to wildlife than the new highway.
examples.trans: 慢车对野生动物比新公路友善。

examples.sentence: A destination that loves wildlife in ads may fence it off the path.
examples.trans: 广告里热爱野生动物的目的地，可能把它挡在小路之外。

passengers.usageZh: 可数名词复数：乘客。单数 passenger。passenger train。

examples.sentence: Passengers waited in the rain.
examples.trans: 乘客在雨中等。

examples.sentence: The passengers shared a charger.
examples.trans: 乘客共用一个充电器。

examples.sentence: Passengers who travel light still carry other people's bags sometimes.
examples.trans: 轻装的乘客有时仍会帮别人提包。

examples.sentence: The train treated passengers as numbers until someone sang.
examples.trans: 火车把乘客当数字，直到有人唱歌。

examples.sentence: Night passengers know which stations still have water.
examples.trans: 夜间乘客知道哪些站还有水。

examples.sentence: A timetable that ignores passengers' bladders is not clever; it is cruel.
examples.trans: 无视乘客膀胱的时刻表不是聪明，是残酷。

sightseeing.usageZh: 不可数名词：观光 go sightseeing。名词 sightseer；sights 名胜。

examples.sentence: We went sightseeing after breakfast.
examples.trans: 早饭后我们去观光。

examples.sentence: Sightseeing tired the child more than the train.
examples.trans: 观光比火车更让孩子累。

examples.sentence: Too much sightseeing leaves no time to sit.
examples.trans: 太多观光就没有时间坐。

examples.sentence: Sightseeing lists rarely include the laundry where travellers actually talk.
examples.trans: 观光清单很少包括旅客真正谈话的洗衣店。

examples.sentence: They skipped sightseeing and watched the river from a bench.
examples.trans: 他们跳过观光，坐在长凳上看河。

examples.sentence: A city addicted to sightseeing may forget its own night shift.
examples.trans: 沉迷观光的城市可能忘记自己的夜班。

opportunities.usageZh: 可数名词复数：机会。单数 opportunity。opportunity to do / for doing。

examples.sentence: Travel brings new opportunities.
examples.trans: 旅行带来新机会。

examples.sentence: The delay was an opportunity to eat together.
examples.trans: 延误成了一起吃饭的机会。

examples.sentence: Cheap night trains are opportunities for workers, not only for backpackers.
examples.trans: 便宜夜车是工人的机会，而不只是背包客的。

examples.sentence: Opportunities packed as 'once in a lifetime' often run twice a day.
examples.trans: 包装成“一生一次”的机会，往往一天有两班。

examples.sentence: She used the opportunity of a window to learn the names of trees.
examples.trans: 她利用靠窗的机会学习树的名字。

examples.sentence: A city of opportunities still needs a bus that reaches them before dawn.
examples.trans: 机会之城仍需要一班黎明前能到达的公交车。

world view.usageZh: 名词短语：世界观。也可 worldview。复数 world views。

examples.sentence: Travel can change your world view.
examples.trans: 旅行能改变你的世界观。

examples.sentence: His world view grew after one slow train.
examples.trans: 一班慢车之后，他的世界观变大了。

examples.sentence: A world view made only of airports is a thin map.
examples.trans: 只由机场构成的世界观是一张薄地图。

examples.sentence: She packed a world view that included who sweeps the station.
examples.trans: 她装进的世界观包括谁打扫车站。

examples.sentence: Their children's world view started with shared fruit on a bench.
examples.trans: 孩子们的世界观从长凳上分享的水果开始。

examples.sentence: World views sold as products rarely mention visas.
examples.trans: 当产品出售的世界观很少提及签证。

loved ones.usageZh: 名词短语：亲人、所爱的人。复数概念。

examples.sentence: Call your loved ones tonight.
examples.trans: 今晚给亲人打电话。

examples.sentence: She travelled to see loved ones, not palaces.
examples.trans: 她去看亲人，不是看宫殿。

examples.sentence: Tickets to loved ones should not cost a month's food.
examples.trans: 去看亲人的票，不该花掉一个月的食物。

examples.sentence: Loved ones waiting at a station are a kind of architecture.
examples.trans: 在车站等候的亲人是一种建筑。

examples.sentence: He packed gifts for loved ones and water for himself.
examples.trans: 他给亲人装了礼物，给自己装了水。

examples.sentence: A network that connects loved ones still needs a night bus.
examples.trans: 连接亲人的网络，仍需要夜班车。

comparing to.usageZh: 口语中出现的比较说法；更规范 compared to/with。compare A to B。

examples.sentence: Comparing to last year, this train is quieter.
examples.trans: 和去年比，这班火车更安静。

examples.sentence: Comparing to the plane, the train let us walk.
examples.trans: 和飞机比，火车让我们能走动。

examples.sentence: Comparing to the brochure, the town had more bins.
examples.trans: 和手册比，镇子垃圾桶更多。

examples.sentence: Comparing to a crowded tour, the slow path was luxury.
examples.trans: 和拥挤的团游比，慢路是奢侈。

examples.sentence: She kept comparing to home and then stopped, which helped.
examples.trans: 她不停拿家乡比，后来停了，这有帮助。

examples.sentence: Comparing to a visa-free neighbour is not a fair test of a poorer station.
examples.trans: 拿免签邻居来比，不是对更穷车站的公平测试。

a bunch of.usageZh: 量词短语：一束、一堆 a bunch of flowers/keys/people。非正式。

examples.sentence: She bought a bunch of grapes.
examples.trans: 她买了一串葡萄。

examples.sentence: A bunch of keys rang in the conductor's pocket.
examples.trans: 一串钥匙在列车员口袋里响。

examples.sentence: A bunch of backpackers filled the last carriage.
examples.trans: 一群背包客装满了最后一节车厢。

examples.sentence: He gave her a bunch of tickets like a bouquet.
examples.trans: 他把一叠车票当花束递给她。

examples.sentence: A bunch of delays taught them to pack nuts.
examples.trans: 一堆延误教会他们装坚果。

examples.sentence: A bunch of perfect photos can still hide a bunch of unpaid shifts.
examples.trans: 一堆完美照片仍可能藏着一堆无酬班次。

away from.usageZh: 介词短语：离开、远离 stay/keep/go away from。

examples.sentence: Keep the bag away from the door.
examples.trans: 包离门远一点。

examples.sentence: They travelled away from the crowds.
examples.trans: 他们远离人群去旅行。

examples.sentence: A weekend away from email is still a timetable.
examples.trans: 远离邮件的周末仍是一张时间表。

examples.sentence: Sitting away from the window saved her from the sun.
examples.trans: 坐得离窗远，让她躲过太阳。

examples.sentence: The path led away from the photographed square.
examples.trans: 小路带人离开被拍照的广场。

examples.sentence: Getting away from work is harder when work owns the night train.
examples.trans: 当工作占有夜车时，远离工作更难。

go for.usageZh: 短语动词：选择 go for the slow train；也可去取、攻击。

examples.sentence: Let's go for the window seats.
examples.trans: 我们选靠窗座位吧。

examples.sentence: They went for the slow train on purpose.
examples.trans: 他们故意选了慢车。

examples.sentence: If you go for the cheapest flight, pack patience.
examples.trans: 如果你选最便宜的航班，请装上耐心。

examples.sentence: She went for water while he watched the bags.
examples.trans: 她去取水，他看着包。

examples.sentence: Go for shade before you go for the view.
examples.trans: 先选树荫，再选景色。

examples.sentence: Cities go for tourist numbers and then wonder where the benches went.
examples.trans: 城市追求游客数字，然后奇怪长凳去哪了。

based on.usageZh: 过去分词短语：基于 based on facts。base A on B。

examples.sentence: The story is based on a real train.
examples.trans: 这故事基于一列真火车。

examples.sentence: Advice based on brochures will miss the closed tap.
examples.trans: 基于手册的建议会错过关掉的水龙头。

examples.sentence: Their route was based on where relatives still kept keys.
examples.trans: 他们的路线基于亲戚仍留着钥匙的地方。

examples.sentence: A timetable based on wishes will punish bladders.
examples.trans: 基于愿望的时刻表会惩罚膀胱。

examples.sentence: Prices based on 'peak joy' ignore night workers.
examples.trans: 基于“高峰喜悦”的价格忽视夜班工人。

examples.sentence: Policy based on photographs will underfund the sweepers.
examples.trans: 基于照片的政策会少资助扫地的人。

crowds of.usageZh: 量词：成群的 crowds of people/tourists。

examples.sentence: Crowds of gulls followed the boat.
examples.trans: 成群的海鸥跟着船。

examples.sentence: Crowds of tourists filled the small lane.
examples.trans: 成群游客挤满小巷。

examples.sentence: Crowds of cameras arrived before the cleaners left.
examples.trans: 成群相机在清洁工离开前到达。

examples.sentence: They fled crowds of drones for a treeless quiet.
examples.trans: 他们逃离成群无人机，去无树的安静里。

examples.sentence: Crowds of cheap tickets can still mean one crowded toilet.
examples.trans: 成堆便宜票仍可能意味着一个拥挤厕所。

examples.sentence: Managing crowds of visitors without crowds of bins is a dare.
examples.trans: 管理成群游客却没有成群垃圾桶，是一种挑衅。

trade it for.usageZh: 动词短语：用它交换 trade A for B。it 指前文之物。

examples.sentence: I will trade it for a sandwich.
examples.trans: 我愿意用它换一个三明治。

examples.sentence: She traded the flight for a slow train.
examples.trans: 她用航班换了慢车。

examples.sentence: They traded the palace ticket for an afternoon of shade.
examples.trans: 他们用宫殿票换了一个下午的树荫。

examples.sentence: He would not trade it for a faster seat without a window.
examples.trans: 没有窗的更快座位，他不愿拿来换。

examples.sentence: Trade speed for talk and the journey lengthens in the good way.
examples.trans: 用速度换谈话，旅程会以好的方式变长。

examples.sentence: Cities trade quiet for numbers, then buy noise machines.
examples.trans: 城市用安静换数字，然后去买噪声机器。

break time.usageZh: 名词短语：休息时间。也可 breaktime。take a break。

examples.sentence: Break time is for water.
examples.trans: 休息时间用来喝水。

examples.sentence: The train's break time was a platform with one tap.
examples.trans: 火车的休息时间是只有一个水龙头的月台。

examples.sentence: They used break time to call loved ones.
examples.trans: 他们用休息时间给亲人打电话。

examples.sentence: A holiday without break time is just a farther shift.
examples.trans: 没有休息时间的假期，只是更远的一班。

examples.sentence: Drivers need real break time, not a slogan on the cab wall.
examples.trans: 司机需要真正的休息时间，不是驾驶室墙上的口号。

examples.sentence: Cities that sell 24-hour fun still owe someone a break time.
examples.trans: 贩卖24小时欢乐的城市，仍欠某个人一段休息。

break away from.usageZh: 短语动词：脱离 break away from a crowd/habit。过去 broke away。

examples.sentence: The dog broke away from the leash.
examples.trans: 狗挣脱了绳子。

examples.sentence: They broke away from the tour to find shade.
examples.trans: 他们脱离旅行团去找树荫。

examples.sentence: Break away from the pin on the map if the queue is a kilometre.
examples.trans: 如果队伍有一公里，就脱离地图上的图钉。

examples.sentence: She broke away from mainstream flights and learned stations.
examples.trans: 她脱离主流航班，学会了车站。

examples.sentence: To break away from a photographed route is a kind of manners.
examples.trans: 脱离被拍照的路线，是一种礼貌。

examples.sentence: A town that cannot break away from one famous corner will choke it.
examples.trans: 无法脱离某一个著名角落的镇子，会把它噎死。

turn out to be.usageZh: 短语：结果是 turn out to be + n/adj。过去 turned out。

examples.sentence: The shortcut turned out to be longer.
examples.trans: 捷径结果更长。

examples.sentence: The cheap hotel turned out to be kind.
examples.trans: 便宜旅馆结果很友善。

examples.sentence: The delay turned out to be a shared meal.
examples.trans: 延误结果成了一顿共享的饭。

examples.sentence: The 'five-minute walk' turned out to be a hill.
examples.trans: “步行五分钟”结果是一座山。

examples.sentence: The unusual route turned out to be the one with water.
examples.trans: 不寻常的路线结果是有水的那条。

examples.sentence: A magnificent square can turn out to be a frying pan at noon.
examples.trans: 壮丽的广场中午可能变成平底锅。

used to be.usageZh: 结构：过去常常/曾经是 used to be/do。否定 didn't use to。不与现在状态直接等同。

examples.sentence: This street used to be quiet.
examples.trans: 这条街曾经很安静。

examples.sentence: There used to be a night train.
examples.trans: 曾经有一班夜车。

examples.sentence: She used to be afraid of ferries.
examples.trans: 她曾经怕渡轮。

examples.sentence: The station used to be a market in the mornings.
examples.trans: 这车站曾经在早晨是市场。

examples.sentence: What used to be a path is now a photographed line.
examples.trans: 曾经是小路的东西，现在是一条被拍照的线。

examples.sentence: A town that used to be for workers now rents their windows to tourists.
examples.trans: 一座曾经属于工人的镇子，现在把他们的窗户租给游客。

first of all.usageZh: 连接语：首先。近义 to begin with, firstly。

examples.sentence: First of all, pack water.
examples.trans: 首先，装上水。

examples.sentence: First of all, they found the shade.
examples.trans: 首先，他们找到了树荫。

examples.sentence: First of all, check whether the night train still exists.
examples.trans: 首先，确认夜车是否还在。

examples.sentence: First of all, ask who works while you sightsee.
examples.trans: 首先，问谁在你观光时工作。

examples.sentence: First of all, the child needed a toilet, not a palace.
examples.trans: 首先，孩子需要厕所，不是宫殿。

examples.sentence: First of all, a journey is a bladder and a bench; then it is a view.
examples.trans: 首先，旅程是膀胱和长凳；然后才是景色。

compared to.usageZh: 过去分词短语：与……相比 compared to/with。

examples.sentence: Compared to the plane, the train was calm.
examples.trans: 和飞机比，火车很平静。

examples.sentence: Compared to last summer, the crowds have doubled.
examples.trans: 和去年夏天比，人群翻倍了。

examples.sentence: Compared to a brochure, the tap was more important.
examples.trans: 和手册比，水龙头更重要。

examples.sentence: Cheap stays, compared to palaces, still need clean sheets.
examples.trans: 便宜住处和宫殿相比，仍需要干净床单。

examples.sentence: Compared to the photographed square, the laundry was friendlier.
examples.trans: 和被拍照的广场比，洗衣店更友善。

examples.sentence: Compared to a visa, a missed train is a small grief.
examples.trans: 和签证相比，误一班火车是小悲伤。

from door to door.usageZh: 副词短语：挨家挨户；全程 from door to door service。

examples.sentence: The rain followed us from door to door.
examples.trans: 雨从一扇门跟到另一扇门。

examples.sentence: They travelled from door to door with one backpack.
examples.trans: 他们用一个背包门到门地旅行。

examples.sentence: A taxi from door to door cost more than the train.
examples.trans: 门到门的出租车比火车贵。

examples.sentence: From door to door, the journey was eight hours of kind strangers.
examples.trans: 从门到门，旅程是八小时善良的陌生人。

examples.sentence: Services from door to door still leave someone standing in weather.

the same as 是同级结构。
not so...as 只能用于肯定句。
the same：这汤和奶奶的一样。→ This soup is ____ Grandma's.

not so：他没她那么累。→ He is not so tired ____ she is.

as...as possible 等于 as...as one can。
as many as 接不可数名词。

as possible：尽量少噪声。→ Keep ____ noise as possible.
not so：睡眠不像口号那么便宜。→ Sleep is not so cheap ____ slogans suggest.

exercises.answer: No two nights are as equal as a poster claims.

exercises.answer: There are not as many window seats.

twice more...as 比 twice as 更稳妥。

not as：休息不像口号便宜。→ Rest is ____ slogans suggest.

as carefully as 中 carefully 是副词。
倍数：被打断的睡眠比嗓门代价高三倍。→ Interrupted sleep is ____ a raised voice.
副词：对待时数要像对待钱一样小心。→ Treat hours ____ money.

as fully as 修饰动词 count。

much：未命名劳动和点名增长一样多。→ There is ____ unnamed labour as named growth.

grammar.key: Modal Verb 'can' for Ability/Possibility / 情态动词'can'表能力/可能性
grammar.title: can / could / be able to：能力、可能、许可与 can't have done
grammar.titleEn: Can for ability, possibility, permission, and related forms
grammar.usage: can 表能力、可能、许可。过去 could；将来 be able to。否定 cannot/can't。推测：can't have done。高中：can 表理论可能；could 更委婉。
notes: can 后无 to、无 -s。
将来能力 will be able to，不是 will can。
许可：Can I...? May I...? 更正式。
can't 表不可能（推测）。
过去某次成功用 was able to/managed to。

examples.en: She can read a map.
You can sit here.
It can rain on the plain.
They were able to catch the last train.
He can't have packed that much in one bag.
examples.cn: 他不可能一个包装那么多。

exercises.q: She ____ read a map.
____ I sit here?
He cannot ____ the heavy bag.
选择正确句子。
We ____ able to wait.
Tom can ____ (run) fast.
____ you help me?
She cannot ____ (find) the gate.
can 后接动词原形。
He cans swim 正确。
能力：她会读地图。→ She ____ a map.
许可：我可以坐这吗？→ ____ I sit here?
be able to：我们能够等。→ We ____ able to wait.
改错：She can to read a map.
改错：They cans swim.
It ____ rain on the treeless road.
May I ____ the window?
They will be able to ____ the last train.
When he was five he ____ swim.
You ____ not take photos here. （禁止）
We could ____ (see) the lake from the train.
Will she be able to ____ (carry) both bags?
It can ____ (get) crowded at dusk.
will can 不正确。
could 可表过去能力。
将来：他们将能赶上末班车。→ They will ____ catch the last train.
过去：五岁就会游。→ When he was five he ____ swim.
可能：无树路上可能下雨。→ It ____ rain on the treeless road.
改错：They will can catch the train.
exercises.answer: They will be able to catch the last train.

exercises.q: 改错：May I to open the window?
A slow train can ____ kinder than a cheap flight.
She was able to ____ a window seat after all.
You could ____ the conductor for shade advice.
He can't ____ packed four pans in that bag.
Wildlife can ____ if corridors remain.
They managed to ____ (board) without a reservation.
Could you ____ (keep) my seat?
The delay can't ____ (be) a surprise; the app lied.
某次成功用 was able to / managed to，不用笼统 could。
can't have done 是对过去的否定推测。
某次：她终究拿到靠窗座位。→ She ____ get a window seat after all.
推测：他不可能装了四口锅。→ He can't ____ packed four pans.
委婉：你可以问问列车员。→ You ____ ask the conductor.
改错：She could get the seat after all. （某次成功更宜 was able to）
exercises.answer: She was able to get a window seat after all.

exercises.q: 改错：He can't has packed four pans.
exercises.answer: He can't have packed four pans in that bag.

exercises.q: A city can ____ night trains; it cannot cut the people who needed them.
Tourists may ____ photos; they may not block the cleaner.
The brochure can't ____ mentioned the closed tap.
We should be able to ____ shade as infrastructure.
Could the last train ____ after ten?
Workers must be able to ____ (get) home after a night shift.
The delay can't ____ (be) accidental twice.
Might we ____ (keep) one night train?
may 许可与 may 可能要靠语境。
should be able to 表合理预期。
不能：城市不能砍掉需要夜车的人。→ it cannot ____ the people who needed them
推测：手册不可能提到了关掉的水龙头。→ The brochure can't ____ mentioned the closed tap.
should be able to：我们应能把树荫当基础设施。→ We should ____ treat shade as infrastructure.
改错：The brochure can't has mentioned the tap.
exercises.answer: The brochure can't have mentioned the closed tap.

exercises.q: 改错：We should can treat shade as infrastructure.
exercises.answer: We should be able to treat shade as infrastructure.

exercises.q: Pins can ____ queues when every backpacker follows one photo.
A square cannot ____ kind at noon if it is treeless.
They could have ____ the slow train; they chose speed.
Might the cons ____ printed beside the pros?
Night staff have been able to ____ the station with one tap.
The town can't ____ (fence) wildlife and praise it too.
Could cheaper tickets ____ (include) water?
We may not ____ (block) the cleaner for a photo.
could have done 表过去本可以而未做。
have been able to 是能力的完成体。
本可以：他们本可以坐慢车。→ They could ____ the slow train.
完成能力：夜班员工一直能用一个水龙头维持车站。→ Night staff have ____ keep the station with one tap.
可能：图钉能变成队伍。→ Pins can ____ queues.
改错：They could have take the slow train.
exercises.answer: They could have taken the slow train.

exercises.q: 改错：A square cannot stays kind at noon.
exercises.answer: A square cannot stay kind at noon if it is treeless.

exercises.q: A destination can ____ marvellous in ink and cruel at 4 a.m.

Might wildlife ____ a corridor that cameras do not own?

Cities can ____ (sell) destinations; they cannot pretend journeys are free.
The queue can't ____ (be) scenery if someone in it must get to work.
Could the brochure ____ (print) waiting times?
情态被动 might be given 表不确定许可/可能。
ought to be able to 把义务和能力叠在一起。
对照：目的地可以在墨水里奇妙。→ A destination can ____ marvellous in ink.
被动：野生动物能否得到相机不占有的走廊？→ Might wildlife ____ a corridor...?
ought to be able to：我们应当能把末班车算作平等。→ We ought to ____ count last trains as equality.
改错：The postcard can't has cropped the clinic.
exercises.answer: The postcard can't have cropped the clinic by accident every time.

grammar.key: Gerund as Subject / 动名词作主语（扩展：动名词与不定式）
grammar.title: 动名词主语再探：It's no use / look forward to / 复合结构
grammar.titleEn: Gerund versus infinitive as subject and after prepositions
grammar.usage: 动名词作主语把活动名物化：Sharing the maps keeps peace。谓语单数。也可用 It is + adj. + to do。否定 Not naming the hours delayed the peace。高中：复合结构 their sharing；There is no denying。
forms: 动名词短语 + 单数谓语
notes: 主语用单数谓语。
介词后用动名词。
It's no use + gerund。
look forward to + gerund。
不定式更偏具体一次性。

____ in line made us hungry.
____ (run) in the morning feels fresh.

动名词主语用单数谓语。
Sharing are kind 正确。
不定式改动名词：To wait is hard. → ____ is hard.
单数：Reading make me calm. → Reading ____ me calm.

改错：To cooking takes time.
____ a second language opens songs.

____ the door unlocked is unsafe.
It is important ____ the path.

____ (share) the maps keeps peace.

Wearing a helmet ____ (protect) you.
It is + adj. + to do 与动名词主语都能成立。
介词 after 后接 to do。
改写：It is fair to share. → ____ is fair.
it 句：Waiting is boring. → It is boring ____.
否定：Knowing the hours helped. → ____ the hours delayed peace.

改错：Making model are hard.
____ long queues shortens tempers.
There is no ____ that the platform tells the truth.
____ him wait at the gate was unkind.
It's no use ____ over spilled soup.
The hardest part is ____ where to start.
____ (name) the hours helps.
It's worth ____ (check) who cooked.
Not ____ (sleep) made the argument louder.
It's no use 后接动名词。
There is no + 动词原形。
there is no：不可否认水槽说实话。→ There is no ____ that the platform tells the truth.
no use：洒了汤哭没用。→ It's no use ____ over spilled soup.
主语：忽视无偿时数。→ ____ long queues shortens tempers.

exercises.answer: It's no use crying over spilled soup.

look forward to 的 to 是介词。

look forward to：盼望见到资助的时数。→ look forward to ____ funded hours
there is no：不可否认地图跳过村子。→ There is no ____ the map skipped villages.

exercises.answer: We look forward to seeing funded hours.

hiding：隐瞒延误会失去信任。→ ____ the delay loses trust.
